claims.object_text: lower CSF SNAP25 in MS compared to AD
claims.quote: Compared to AD, MS had higher CSF sCD27 (p < 0.001) but lower serum CHI3L1 and GFAP, and CSF OPN and SNAP25 (all p < 0.05).

claims.object_text: no difference in SNAP25 between RRMS and PPMS
claims.quote: Soluble and post-mortem tissue biomarkers did not differ between pwRRMS and pwPPMS.
